name: hh-meanrev-micro: RSI capitulation bounce, liquid majors (30m)
rationale: MECHANISM: identical RSI seller-exhaustion bounce on liquid majors as the 15m variant — an oversold print marks the marginal panic seller being done and the bid ladder lifting price back to VWAP — but on the 30m bar, where the larger absolute bounce more comfortably clears the fixed round-trip cost, at the price of fewer events. The timeframe axis tests whether capitulation-bounce is a genuine multi-timescale behavioral effect or a fast-bar microstructure blip. Entry: rsi deeply oversold AND bb_z confirming. Long-only spot; exit as rsi recovers. DISCONFIRMER: if the 30m net Sharpe after fees is indistinguishable from the 15m variant, the timeframe adds nothing — keep one. Run the SAME rule on the alt basket: if majors are positive but alts negative, it is a fee-arb not a signal. If it cannot beat buy-and-hold on majors, the bounce is smaller than the interrupted trend — kill.
catalyst: RSI capitulation bounce on majors, slower 30m clock for cost headroom
